newsitem.title: MEXICO: Sanluis reports 9-mo net up 45 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sanluis reports 9-mo net up 45 pct.

text.p: Mexico's auto parts and mining conglomerate Sanluis Corporacion said Friday that its 9-month net earnings were up 45 percent over the same period a year earlier to 320 million pesos. No comparative figure was given for the first 9 months of 1995.
The company said that translates to earnings per share of 1.34 pesos for the company's A shares and 4.03 pesos for its CPO series.
Sanluis said earnings in the third quarter were 108 million pesos, up 40 percent on the same period a year earlier. Again, no comparative figure was given.
Sanluis said its third quarter earnings rise reflected "an improvement in operating profits and a reduction of financial expenditures and forex losses in the period."

Sanluis said sales rose to $168 million in the first nine months, up 28 percent. In pesos, consolidated sales to September were 1.353 billion pesos, a 15 percent rise over the same period a year earlier.
Consolidated operating profits to September were 321 million pesos, with an operating margin of 24 percent, Sanluis said.
Sanluis said its mining division saw record productions in gold and silver, which alongside the growth in autoparts sales, allowed the increases in sales and operating profits.
